mapper.select: select count(1) from sys_user where dept_id = #{deptId} and del_flag = '0'

mapper.insert: insert into sys_dept( dept_id, parent_id, dept_name, ancestors, order_num, leader_id, leader, fgld_id, fgld_name, bank_name, account, social_code, postal_code, address, phone, email, status, create_by, is_zbzg, is_uint, tree_leavel, sub_code, dept_jc, tenant_id, create_time )values( #{deptId}, #{parentId}, #{deptName}, #{ancestors}, #{orderNum}, #{leaderId}, #{leader}, #{fgldId}, #{fgldName}, #{bankName}, #{account}, #{socialCode}, #{postalCode}, #{address}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{status}, #{createBy}, #{isZbzg}, #{isUint}, #{treeLeavel}, #{subCode}, #{deptJc}, #{tenantId}, sysdate() )
mapper.update:
update sys_dept
status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate()
where dept_id in (${ancestors})
